verdict.rationale: Elastic's own marketing describes the nightshift AI SRE, which investigates incidents and delivers an evidence-backed root cause. It also offers natural-language interaction with telemetry, so the product itself produces AI-generated incident analysis. The evidence is marketing-level only and never explicitly describes summarizing alerts or packaging alert context for responders. missing for 10: explicit AI-generated summaries of alerts and their context, documentation of how summaries reach responders (e.g. in Cases or notifications), in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
